items.title: Judge throws out appeals over homophobic tweet judgement
items.description: A Federal Court judge has dismissed an appeal against a judgement which ordered New South Wales MP Mark Latham to pay $140,000 to independent MP Alex Greenwich over a homophobic tweet in 2023.

items.title: 'It's an unprecedented matter': Bondi gunman hit with 19 more charges
items.description: Akram is facing charges of murder and committing a terrorist act over the attack at Bondi Beach on 14 December.

items.title: Live: Woolworths set to outsource hundreds of jobs from corporate office
items.description: Supermarket giant Woolworths will begin consulting with its 10,000 corporate workers today, with plans to outsource roles to Asia. The Australian share market has begun its day relatively flat. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Iran attacks US navy base after US retaliates over helicopter downing
items.description: Iran says it struck the US Navy's Fifth Fleet base in Bahrain with drones following a series of US strikes on Iranian cities along the Strait of Hormuz. Follow live.

items.title: Live: PM 'very worried' about the impact of fresh attacks in Iran war
items.description: Anthony Albanese wants to see a "de-escalation" following the latest strikes in the Middle East. Follow live.

items.title: Why Xi Jinping made an exception to see Kim Jong Un in person
items.description: Xi Jinping and Kim Jong Un's bilateral talks in North Korea were a big departure from the Chinese president's usual diplomacy playbook because, for this first time this year, he was the one travelling abroad to make the meeting happen.

items.title: Thirteen government agencies embroiled in potential data breach
items.description: Thirteen government agencies are now embroiled in an expanding scandal involving potential data breaches prompting calls for an urgent audit amid concerns over national security.

items.title: Too poor to leave Australia. These people are trapped with no safety net
items.description: A man dies. His body is not noticed for nearly a week. He was invisible to many, like the growing number of homeless Australia wide.

items.title: 'We didn't know how dangerous he was': How Rolf Harris hid in plain sight
items.description: Rolf Harris's conviction for child sexual abuse was shocking to those who saw him as a lovable larrikin. But the people who were abused by him are refusing to stay silent about the impacts of his crimes.

items.title: Protests erupt in Belfast after stabbing attack, homes, cars and bus set on fire
items.description: Protesters hold anti-immigration demonstrations in Northern Ireland and England after a Sudanese man is arrested over a "brutal" knife attack in Belfast.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
